items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: later on, Izzy Freeman would play, kind of, with Paul White in his band, too.

ctx.x: Or it could have been a, a gathering of a lodge. You understand? Yeah, I see. That would have a dinner, or any kind of a seminar, or whatever you want to call those things, that, uh, somebody wanted to speak, uh, at the time, you know. But that, that, that's the, that's the place where the Wolverines played for a while, see. Mm-hmm. And then later on, Jack Tilson got the band, and Jack Tilson was, he was a promoter, see, politician guy. And later on, he became one of the councilmen in, in Annapolis. Mm-hmm. But…
